commit_note: Core와 앱 9개는 de1542f 위 미커밋 변경으로 실행한 뒤 6642b7c에 확정했다. 환경 파일의 원본 HEAD/dirty 목록을 그대로 보존한다. 다운로드 복합 3개와 원격 CI는 6642b7c에서 실행했다.

final_native_rerun.context: After runtime network loss in oQvxoW; new owned simulator after connectivity recovered. Both outcomes retained.

observation_check.scope: New owned simulator. Actual HLS completion, relaunch, playback and deletion; actual paused seek completion and displayed time.

rotation_check.scope: Presentation timing change verified before commit; teardown-only test cleanup added after this run compiled. Remote suite validates the committed harness.

extended_smoke_check.working_changes: Debug opt-in 600-second own demo; smoke observes paused origin plus ten seconds; accessibility uses same fixture
extended_smoke_check.result: 2 tests passed; source changes subsequently committed with the extended subtitle/profile cases

extended_boundary_initial_failure.result: F04 passed (73.500s); subtitle check failed after requesting 5/600 slider position: actual seek was 00:00:10, expected 4–6 seconds.
extended_boundary_initial_failure.fix: Superseded: a zero-position request also produced no editing event. The final test first observes the middle, then drags to the initial caption range. See the second failure.

extended_boundary_second_failure.result: F04 passed 64.899s; subtitle adjustment to zero retained the paused 10-second position. App diagnostics show no scrub_end/seek_started after pause.
extended_boundary_second_failure.scope: XCTest action did not produce a player seek; not a seek completion failure.
extended_boundary_second_failure.fix: First move to and observe the middle, then drag back and verify the first caption time range, plus forward/backward caption changes.
